# Introduction {data-section="Introduction"}

## About this Extension

This extension adds a **premium**, **interactive** progress indicator to your Quarto presentations.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Key Feature
It runs purely on **JavaScript & CSS** with zero Lua dependencies!
:::

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/ofurkancoban/quarto-progress-indicator)

## How It Works

1.  **Tracking**: Listens to Reveal.js events.
2.  **Grouping**: Groups slides by sections.
3.  **Interaction**: Fully interactive dots and settings.

# Interactive Settings {data-section="Interactive Features"}

## Display Settings Panel

Press <kbd>c</kbd> anywhere in the presentation to open the **Configuration Menu**.

- **Position**: Toggle Top/Bottom.
- **Alignment**: Left/Center/Right.
- **Sliders**: Adjust dot size and spacing live.
- **Visibility**: Toggle indicator on/off for specific slides.

## Theme Palettes

Choose from a variety of **Professional Palettes** using visual swatches:

- **Nord**: Clean Arctic Blue
- **Indigo**: Modern Purple/Blue
- **Emerald**: Muted Professional Green
- **Slate**: Corporate Grey/Blue
- **Cyber**: Vibrant Modern Cyan

## Active Animations

Add flair to your active slide with CSS animations:

- **Pulse**: Soft breathing effect.
- **Glow**: Subtle luminous highlight.
- **Bounce**: Playful jumping dot.

# Configuration {data-section="Setup"}

## Installation

```bash
quarto add ofurkancoban/QuartoProgressIndicator
```

## Setup in YAML

```yaml
format:
  revealjs:
    include-after-body: _extensions/ofurkancoban/progress-indicator/progress-indicator.html
    progress-indicator:
      position: "bottom"
      style: "dots"
```

## CSS Customization

```css
:root {
  --primary-color: #3b60e4;
  --inactive-color: #bbbbbb;
  --dot-size: 8px;
}
```

# Shortcuts & Tips {data-section="Tips"}

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| <kbd>c</kbd> | Open Display Settings |
| <kbd>x</kbd> | Hide/Show Indicator |

## Hidden Slides

Add the `.hide-progress` class to any slide to hide the indicator:

```markdown
## QA Slide {.hide-progress}
```

# Conclusion {data-section="Conclusion"}

## Summary

-   **Zero** Lua dependencies.
-   **Visual** theme selection.
-   **Smart** persistence across reloads.
-   **Easy** installation & extraction.
